name: Castra Lemanis
summary: Portus Lemanis, also known as Lemanae, was the Latin name of a Roman Saxon Shore fort, settlement and port in southern Kent. The modern village of Lympne derives its name from the ancient port. The site, known locally as Stutfall Castle, is on private land which is accessible by public footpath.
aka: Saxon Shore fort now called Stutfall Castle, 468m south-west of St Stephen's Church, Lympne Roman fort
